MINUTES OF THE MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN LIMITED
(“COMPANY”) HELD ON 25th DAY OF AUGUST 2020
Agenda
ADVANCEMENT OF LOAN TO ZAMEEN MEDIA (PRIVATE) LIMITED
The Board was informed that the Company desires to advance a loan in the principal amount
of AED 3,600,000 (Emirati Dirham Three Million Six Hundred Thousand) to Zameen Media
(Private) Limited (“Borrower”). The Board unanimously nominated Gilles Christophe Marc
Blanchard, Director of the Company, to discuss, negotiate, and accept this proposal.
Resolutions
After discussing the aforesaid matter
passed/approved/adopted by the Board:

in

detail,

the following

resolutions

were

1. Resolved by the Board that the Company advance a loan in the principal amount of
AED 3,600,000 (Emirati Dirham Three Million Six Hundred Thousand) to the Borrower.
2. Resolved further by the Board that Gilles Christophe Marc Blanchard is hereby
authorized and empowered to do and execute all such acts, deeds and things as may
be necessary and ancillary to the aforementioned transaction.

_____________________________
Gilles Christophe Marc Blanchard
Director
